note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 (independent auditor). RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Connect): "In response to any other events (Events 8, 10-11, 13, 19, 23, 25-28), the local system: - if the ConnectRetryTimer is running, stops and resets the ConnectRetryTimer (sets to zero), - if the DelayOpenTimer is running, stops and resets the DelayOpenTimer (sets to zero), - releases all BGP resources, - drops the TCP connection, - increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1, - performs peer oscillation damping if the DampPeerOscillations attribute is set to True, and - changes its state to Idle." (rfc/full/rfc4271.txt lines 3226-3244) Downgraded from enforced to weak because the code moved under the previous judgement, not the tests: the previous verdict rested on 'Ze has no DelayOpenTimer and never starts the ConnectRetryTimer, so both conditional clauses never trigger'. b6d84e8104 implemented configurable DelayOpen: in Connect, Event 17 with DelayOpen set now holds the TCP connection with a running DelayOpenTimer (handleDelayOpen), and Connect Event 18 with a running DelayOpenTimer starts the ConnectRetryTimer. The DelayOpenTimer clause, and dropping the held TCP connection, are now reachable, and no tagged unit runs with a DelayOpenTimer: the FSM units use crcFSM with no timers installed, and the peer units (Connect Event 8 during the dial, Event 1 negative) configure no DelayOpen. FSM.change stops the DelayOpenTimer on every Idle entry, so the code complies today, but removing that stop would leave every tagged unit green. What the tagged units still enforce: counter 3 -> 4 and Idle for Events 8, 10, 11, 19, 23, 25-28 in Connect (and Active, supplementary), Events 1/6/9 keeping state and counter, and at peer level the dial-time Event 8 release (no OPEN, conn nil, timers stopped, counter 4). Fix: tag internal/component/bgp/fsm/delay_open_test.go::TestRFC4271DelayOpenEventsConnect (untagged today; it drives each listed event in Connect with a running DelayOpenTimer and requires Idle, counter 4, DelayOpenTimer and ConnectRetryTimer not running) as a positive of this row with a discrimination record that removes FSM.change's StopDelayOpenTimer, and add a peer-level held-connection case for the TCP-drop clause. Tagged units ran green 2026-10-31 under -race.
